36	class ExecNode:
37	    """A compiled field in the query selection tree.
38	
39	    Leaf fields carry ``field_type`` and no children. Link fields also carry
40	    the validated @link mapping (local/target field names, target entity) and
41	    their compiled children; ``is_list`` selects list resolution.
42	    """
43	
44	    __slots__ = (
45	        "response_key",
46	        "field_name",
47	        "field_type",
48	        "required",
49	        "is_list",
50	        "local",
51	        "local_types",
52	        "target",
53	        "target_types",
54	        "target_table",
55	        "children",
56	        "type_name",
57	    )
58	
59	    def __init__(
60	        self,
61	        response_key: str,
62	        field_name: str,
63	        field_type=None,
64	        required: bool = False,
65	        is_list: bool = False,
66	        local: Optional[List[str]] = None,

70	        target_table: Optional[str] = None,
71	        children: Optional[List["ExecNode"]] = None,

75	        self.field_name = field_name
76	        self.field_type = field_type

78	        self.is_list = is_list
79	        self.local = local

89	class ExecContext:
90	    """Everything execution needs beyond the compiled roots."""
91	
92	    __slots__ = ("schema", "entity_keys", "key_types", "snapshots")
93	
94	    def __init__(self, schema: Schema, entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
95	                 key_types: Dict[str, List[Any]]):
96	        self.schema = schema
97	        self.entity_keys = entity_keys
98	        # table -> primary key field type refs, in declared order
99	        self.key_types = key_types

103	class QueryCompiler(Planner):
104	    """Compiles a query document into one executable entry per root field."""
105	
106	    def __init__(self, schema: Schema, variables: Dict[str, Any],
107	                 bound_args_allowed: bool = False):
108	        super().__init__(schema, variables, bound_args_allowed)
109	        self.entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
110	        self.key_types: Dict[str, List[Any]] = {}
111	
112	    def compile(
113	        self, query_text: str, source: str, operation_name: Optional[str]
114	    ) -> Tuple[Optional[str], List[dict]]:
115	        operations, self.fragments = parse_executable(query_text, source)
116	        op = self._select_operation(operations, operation_name)
117	        if op.op_type != "query":
118	            raise PlanError(
119	                "UnsupportedOperation",
120	                f"{op.op_type} operations are not supported by query-exec",
121	            )
122	        self.var_map = {}
123	        for name, type_ref, default, has_default in op.var_defs:
124	            if name in self.var_map:
125	                raise PlanError(
126	                    "VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' is declared more than once"
127	                )
128	            self.var_map[name] = (type_ref, default, has_default)
129	
130	        root_type_name = self.schema.roots.get("query")
131	        root_type = self.schema.types.get(root_type_name) if root_type_name else None
132	        if root_type is None:
133	            raise PlanError(
134	                "MappingError",
135	                "schema does not define a root type for query operations",
136	            )
137	
138	        selections = self._expand(op.selection_set, root_type.name, [])
139	        if not selections:
140	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "query has an empty selection set")
141	
142	        roots: List[dict] = []
143	        self.entity_keys = {}
144	        self.key_types = {}
145	        intro = IntroCompiler(self.schema, self._resolve, self.fragments)
146	        for node in selections:
147	            key = node.alias or node.name
148	            # The implicit __typename meta-field may be selected on any object
149	            # type, including the query root; it reports the object type name.
150	            if node.name == "__typename":
151	                IntroCompiler.validate_typename(node)
152	                roots.append(
153	                    {"typename_introspection": key, "name": root_type.name}
154	                )
155	                continue
156	            # Introspection roots cost 0, never touch the entity snapshots and
157	            # are available with or without complexity control.
158	            if node.name == "__schema":
159	                tree = intro.compile_schema_root(node, key)
160	                roots.append({"schema_introspection": key, "tree": tree})
161	                continue
162	            if node.name == "__type":
163	                type_name, tree = intro.compile_type_root(node, key)
164	                roots.append(
165	                    {"type_introspection": key, "tree": tree, "name": type_name}
166	                )
167	                continue
168	            roots.append(self._compile_root(node, root_type))
169	        return op.name, roots
170	
171	    # -- operation selection ---------------------------------------------------
172	
173	    @staticmethod
174	    def _select_operation(operations, operation_name):
175	        if operation_name is not None:
176	            for op in operations:
177	                if op.name == operation_name:
178	                    return op
179	            raise PlanError("InvalidOperation", f"no operation named '{operation_name}'")
180	        if not operations:
181	            raise PlanError("InvalidRequest", "document contains no operations")
182	        if len(operations) == 1:
183	            return operations[0]
184	        raise PlanError(
185	            "InvalidRequest",
186	            "multiple operations found; select one with --operation",
187	        )
188	
189	    # -- roots ------------------------------------------------------------------
190	
191	    def _compile_root(self, node, root_type: TypeInfo) -> dict:
192	        key = node.alias or node.name
193	        field = root_type.fields.get(node.name)
194	        if field is None:
195	            raise PlanError(
196	                "UnknownField",
197	                f"unknown root field '{node.name}' on type '{root_type.name}'",
198	            )
199	        type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
200	        target = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
201	        entity = target.entity if target is not None else None
202	        if entity is None:
203	            raise PlanError(
204	                "UnknownEntity",
205	                f"root field '{node.name}' does not return a mapped entity type",
206	            )
207	        if node.selection_set is None:
208	            raise PlanError(
209	                "InvalidQuery", f"root field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
210	            )
211	        for arg_name, arg_def in field.args.items():
212	            if (
213	                arg_def.type[0] == "non_null"
214	                and not arg_def.has_default
215	                and arg_name not in node.args
216	            ):
217	                raise PlanError(
218	                    "UnknownField",
219	                    f"missing required argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
220	                )
221	        is_list = _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
222	        filter_obj: Dict[str, Any] = {}
223	        filter_types: Dict[str, Any] = {}
224	        for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
225	            if self._accepts_bound_arg(is_list, arg_name):
226	                # A list-size bound used for complexity; never a filter. If it
227	                # is a variable, resolve it so type/required-variable errors
228	                # are reported by the normal validation phase.
229	                if isinstance(value, Var):
230	                    self._resolve(value)
231	                continue
232	            if arg_name not in field.args:
233	                raise PlanError(
234	                    "UnknownField",
235	                    f"unknown argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
236	                )
237	            target_field = target.fields.get(arg_name)
238	            if target_field is None or not self.schema.is_leaf(
239	                named_of(target_field.type_ref)
240	            ):
241	                raise PlanError(
242	                    "UnknownField",
243	                    f"argument '{arg_name}' does not match a filterable field of "
244	                    f"entity '{entity.table}'",
245	                )
246	            filter_obj[arg_name] = self._resolve(value)
247	            filter_types[arg_name] = target_field.type_ref
248	
249	        self.entity_keys[entity.table] = list(entity.key)
250	        self.key_types[entity.table] = [
251	            target.fields[name].type_ref for name in entity.key
252	        ]
253	        children = self._compile_fields(
254	            target, entity, node.selection_set, key
255	        )
256	        return {
257	            "response_key": key,
258	            "field_name": node.name,
259	            "table": entity.table,
260	            "filter": filter_obj,
261	            "filter_types": filter_types,
262	            "is_list": is_list,
263	            "children": children,
264	        }

266	    # -- selection tree -----------------------------------------------------------

268	    def _compile_fields(
269	        self,
270	        info: TypeInfo,
271	        entity: Entity,
272	        selection_set,
273	        path: str,
274	    ) -> List[ExecNode]:
275	        selections = self._expand(selection_set, info.name, [])
276	        if not selections:
277	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", f"empty selection set at '{path}'")
278	        children: List[ExecNode] = []
279	        seen = set()
280	        for node in selections:
281	            key = node.alias or node.name
282	            node_path = f"{path}.{key}"
283	            if node.name == "__schema" or node.name == "__type":
284	                raise PlanError(
285	                    "InvalidQuery",

288	                )
289	            if node.name == "__typename":
290	                if node.args:
291	                    raise PlanError(
292	                        "InvalidQuery",
293	                        "field '__typename' does not take arguments",
294	                    )
295	                if node.selection_set is not None:

297	                        "InvalidQuery",
298	                        "field '__typename' must not have a selection set",
299	                    )
300	                if key not in seen:
301	                    seen.add(key)
302	                    children.append(
303	                        ExecNode(key, "__typename", STRING_TYPE,

305	                    )
306	                continue
307	            field = info.fields.get(node.name)
308	            if field is None:
309	                raise PlanError(
310	                    "UnknownField", f"unknown field '{node.name}' on type '{info.name}'"
311	                )
312	            type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
313	            if self.schema.is_leaf(type_name):
314	                if node.selection_set is not None:
315	                    raise PlanError(
316	                        "InvalidQuery",
317	                        f"scalar field '{node.name}' must not have a selection set",
318	                    )
319	                if node.args:
320	                    raise PlanError(
321	                        "InvalidQuery",
322	                        f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
323	                    )
324	                if key not in seen:
325	                    seen.add(key)
326	                    children.append(ExecNode(key, node.name, field.type_ref))
327	                continue
328	            is_list = _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
329	            for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
330	                if self._accepts_bound_arg(is_list, arg_name):
331	                    if isinstance(value, Var):
332	                        self._resolve(value)
333	                    continue
334	                raise PlanError(
335	                    "InvalidQuery",
336	                    f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
337	                )
338	            if node.selection_set is None:
339	                raise PlanError(
340	                    "InvalidQuery", f"field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
341	                )
342	            required = field.type_ref[0] == "non_null"
343	            if field.link is None:
344	                raise PlanError(
345	                    "MappingError",
346	                    f"field '{info.name}.{node.name}' is missing an @link directive",
347	                )
348	            target_info = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
349	            if target_info is None:
350	                raise PlanError(
351	                    "MappingError",
352	                    f"field '{info.name}.{node.name}' has unsupported type '{type_name}'",
353	                )
354	            target_entity = target_info.entity
355	            if target_entity is None:
356	                raise PlanError(
357	                    "UnknownEntity",
358	                    f"type '{target_info.name}' is not mapped to an entity",
359	                )
360	            local, target_fields, _as_array = field.link
361	            if is_list:
362	                for name in local:
363	                    if not _is_scalar_value_field(self.schema, info.fields.get(name)):
364	                        raise PlanError(
365	                            "MappingError",
366	                            f"@link local field '{name}' of type '{info.name}' "
367	                            f"must be a scalar",
368	                        )
369	                for name in target_fields:
370	                    matched = target_info.fields.get(name)
371	                    if matched is None:
372	                        raise PlanError(
373	                            "MappingError",
374	                            f"@link target field '{name}' is not a field of type "
375	                            f"'{target_info.name}'",
376	                        )
377	                    if not _is_scalar_value_field(self.schema, matched):
378	                        raise PlanError(
379	                            "MappingError",
380	                            f"@link target field '{name}' of type "
381	                            f"'{target_info.name}' must be a scalar",
382	                        )
383	            elif target_fields != target_entity.key:
384	                raise PlanError(
385	                    "InvalidJoin",
386	                    f"@link target {target_fields} does not match the primary key of "
387	                    f"entity '{target_entity.table}'",
388	                )
389	            nested = self._compile_fields(

391	            )
392	            if key not in seen:
393	                seen.add(key)
394	                self.entity_keys[target_entity.table] = list(target_entity.key)
395	                self.key_types[target_entity.table] = [
396	                    target_info.fields[name].type_ref for name in target_entity.key
397	                ]
398	                children.append(
399	                    ExecNode(
400	                        key,
401	                        node.name,
402	                        field.type_ref,
403	                        required=required,
404	                        is_list=is_list,
405	                        local=list(local),
406	                        local_types=[info.fields[n].type_ref for n in local],
407	                        target=list(target_fields),
408	                        target_types=[
409	                            target_info.fields[n].type_ref for n in target_fields
410	                        ],
411	                        target_table=target_entity.table,
412	                        children=nested,
413	                    )
414	                )
415	        return children

418	def _is_scalar_value_field(schema: Schema, field) -> bool:
419	    """Whether a field holds a single (non-list) scalar value."""
420	    if field is None:
421	        return False
422	    return (
423	        not _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
424	        and named_of(field.type_ref) in schema.scalars
425	    )

433	def fold_events(ctx: ExecContext, events_text: str, source: str) -> None:
434	    """Parse and validate every event line, then fold them into snapshots."""
435	    events: List[Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]] = []
436	    for lineno, raw in enumerate(events_text.splitlines(), 1):
437	        line = raw.strip()
438	        if not line:
439	            continue
440	        events.append((lineno, _parse_event(line, source, lineno)))
441	
442	    for lineno, event in events:
443	        _apply_event(ctx, event, source, lineno)
444	
445	
446	def _parse_event(line: str, source: str, lineno: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
447	    try:
448	        event = json.loads(line)
449	    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
450	        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: invalid JSON: {exc.msg}")
451	    if not isinstance(event, dict):
452	        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event must be a JSON object")
453	    for key in ("op", "entity", "before", "after"):
454	        if key not in event:
455	            raise PlanError(
456	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event is missing '{key}'"
457	            )
458	    if event["op"] not in EVENT_OPS:
459	        raise PlanError(
460	            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: unknown op {event['op']!r}"
461	        )
462	    if not isinstance(event["entity"], str) or not event["entity"]:
463	        raise PlanError(
464	            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: 'entity' must be a non-empty string"
465	        )
466	    for key in ("before", "after"):
467	        if event[key] is not None and not isinstance(event[key], dict):
468	            raise PlanError(
469	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: '{key}' must be an object or null"
470	            )
471	    return event

474	def _apply_event(
475	    ctx: ExecContext, event: Dict[str, Any], source: str, lineno: int
476	) -> None:
477	    """Maintain the current snapshot store for one validated event.
478	
479	    Events for entities the query cannot reach are ignored (as in
480	    subscription-push); for every reachable entity the operative snapshot
481	    must carry a well-formed scalar primary key.
482	    """
483	    key_fields = ctx.entity_keys.get(event["entity"])
484	    if key_fields is None:
485	        return
486	    op = event["op"]
487	    if op in ("INSERT", "UPDATE"):
488	        snapshot = event["after"]
489	        if snapshot is None:
490	            raise PlanError(
491	                "EventError",
492	                f"{source}:{lineno}: {op} event requires an 'after' snapshot",
493	            )
494	        key = _require_key(
495	            key_fields, ctx.key_types[event["entity"]], snapshot,
496	            event["entity"], ctx.schema, source, lineno,
497	        )
498	        ctx.snapshots.setdefault(event["entity"], _OrderedStore()).upsert(key, snapshot)
499	        return
500	    snapshot = event["before"]
501	    if snapshot is None:
502	        raise PlanError(
503	            "EventError",
504	            f"{source}:{lineno}: DELETE event requires a 'before' snapshot",
505	        )
506	    key = _require_key(
507	        key_fields, ctx.key_types[event["entity"]], snapshot,
508	        event["entity"], ctx.schema, source, lineno,
509	    )
510	    ctx.snapshots.setdefault(event["entity"], _OrderedStore()).delete(key)

513	def _require_key(
514	    key_fields: List[str],
515	    key_types: List[Any],
516	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
517	    table: str,
518	    schema: Schema,
519	    source: str,
520	    lineno: int,
521	) -> Tuple[Any, ...]:
522	    """Build a primary-key tuple, rejecting any malformed or incomplete one."""
523	    values: List[Any] = []
524	    for name, type_ref in zip(key_fields, key_types):
525	        if name not in snapshot:
526	            raise PlanError(
527	                "EventError",
528	                f"{source}:{lineno}: snapshot of entity '{table}' is missing "
529	                f"primary key field '{name}'",
530	            )
531	        value = snapshot[name]
532	        if value is None or isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
533	            raise PlanError(
534	                "EventError",
535	                f"{source}:{lineno}: primary key field '{name}' of entity '{table}' "
536	                f"cannot be null or a composite value",
537	            )
538	        _check_value_shape(schema, type_ref, value, f"{table}.{name}")
539	        values.append(value)
540	    return tuple(values)

544	# Query execution
545	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

548	def execute(roots: List[dict], ctx: ExecContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
549	    """Answer the compiled query against the current snapshot stores."""
550	    data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
551	    for root in roots:
552	        if "typename_introspection" in root:
553	            data[root["typename_introspection"]] = root["name"]
554	            continue
555	        if "schema_introspection" in root:
556	            data[root["schema_introspection"]] = render_schema_root(
557	                root["tree"], ctx.schema
558	            )
559	            continue
560	        if "type_introspection" in root:
561	            data[root["type_introspection"]] = render_type_root(
562	                root["tree"], root["name"], ctx.schema
563	            )
564	            continue
565	        data[root["response_key"]] = _execute_root(root, ctx)
566	    return {"data": data}

569	def _execute_root(root: dict, ctx: ExecContext) -> Any:
570	    store = ctx.snapshots.get(root["table"])
571	    rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
572	    if store is not None:
573	        for row in store.values():
574	            if _matches_filter(root, row, ctx):
575	                rows.append(row)
576	    path = root["response_key"]
577	    if root["is_list"]:
578	        return [_project(root["children"], row, ctx, path) for row in rows]
579	    if not rows:
580	        return None
581	    if len(rows) > 1:
582	        raise PlanError(
583	            "QueryError",
584	            f"single-object root field '{path}' matched {len(rows)} entities",
585	        )
586	    return _project(root["children"], rows[0], ctx, path)
587

589	def _matches_filter(root: dict, snapshot: Dict[str, Any], ctx: ExecContext) -> bool:
590	    for name, expected in root["filter"].items():
591	        if name not in snapshot:
592	            raise PlanError(
593	                "EventError",
594	                f"snapshot of entity '{root['table']}' is missing filter field "
595	                f"'{name}'",
596	            )
597	        value = snapshot[name]
598	        _check_value_shape(
599	            ctx.schema,
600	            root["filter_types"][name],
601	            value,
602	            f"{root['response_key']}({name})",
603	        )
604	        if value != expected:
605	            return False
606	    return True

609	def _project(
610	    nodes: List[ExecNode],
611	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
612	    ctx: ExecContext,
613	    path: str,
614	) -> Dict[str, Any]:
615	    """Project compiled selections over one entity snapshot."""
616	    data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
617	    for node in nodes:
618	        node_path = f"{path}.{node.response_key}"
619	        if node.field_name == "__typename":
620	            data[node.response_key] = node.type_name
621	            continue
622	        if node.children is None:
623	            if node.field_name not in snapshot:
624	                raise PlanError(
625	                    "EventError",
626	                    f"snapshot is missing field '{node.field_name}' for '{node_path}'",
627	                )
628	            value = snapshot[node.field_name]
629	            _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, node.field_type, value, node_path)
630	            data[node.response_key] = value
631	            continue
632	        if node.is_list:
633	            data[node.response_key] = _project_list(node, snapshot, ctx, node_path)
634	            continue
635	        related = _resolve_object(node, snapshot, ctx, node_path)
636	        if related is None:
637	            if node.required:
638	                raise PlanError(
639	                    "EventError",
640	                    f"non-null relationship '{node_path}' resolved to null",
641	                )
642	            data[node.response_key] = None
643	        else:
644	            data[node.response_key] = _project(
645	                node.children, related, ctx, node_path
646	            )
647	    return data

650	def _project_list(
651	    node: ExecNode,
652	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
653	    ctx: ExecContext,
654	    path: str,
655	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
656	    matches = _resolve_list(node, snapshot, ctx, path)
657	    return [_project(node.children, related, ctx, path) for related in matches]

660	# -- @link resolution -----------------------------------------------------------
661	
662	
663	def _read_local(
664	    node: ExecNode, snapshot: Dict[str, Any], ctx: ExecContext, path: str
665	) -> Optional[List[Any]]:
666	    """Read @link local values; None means any local value is null."""
667	    local_values: List[Any] = []
668	    for name, type_ref in zip(node.local, node.local_types):
669	        if name not in snapshot:
670	            raise PlanError(
671	                "EventError",
672	                f"snapshot is missing local key field '{name}' for '{path}'",
673	            )
674	        value = snapshot[name]
675	        if value is None:
676	            return None
677	        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
678	            raise PlanError(
679	                "EventError",
680	                f"local key field '{name}' for '{path}' cannot form a scalar key",
681	            )
682	        _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, type_ref, value, path)
683	        local_values.append(value)

687	def _check_target_fields(
688	    node: ExecNode, related: Dict[str, Any], ctx: ExecContext, path: str
689	) -> None:
690	    """Ensure every matched target field is present with a compatible scalar."""
691	    for name, type_ref in zip(node.target, node.target_types):
692	        if name not in related:
693	            raise PlanError(
694	                "EventError",
695	                f"target snapshot of entity '{node.target_table}' is missing key "
696	                f"field '{name}' for '{path}'",
697	            )
698	        value = related[name]
699	        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
700	            raise PlanError(
701	                "EventError",
702	                f"target key field '{name}' for '{path}' cannot be matched as a "
703	                f"scalar",
704	            )
705	        if value is not None:
706	            _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, type_ref, value, path)

709	def _check_primary_key(node: ExecNode, ctx: ExecContext, related: Dict[str, Any],
710	                       path: str) -> None:
711	    """Ensure a matched target snapshot supplies a well-formed primary key."""
712	    key_fields = ctx.entity_keys[node.target_table]
713	    key_types = ctx.key_types[node.target_table]
714	    for name, type_ref in zip(key_fields, key_types):
715	        if name not in related:
716	            raise PlanError(
717	                "EventError",
718	                f"target snapshot of entity '{node.target_table}' for '{path}' is "
719	                f"missing primary key field '{name}'",
720	            )
721	        value = related[name]
722	        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)) or value is None:
723	            raise PlanError(
724	                "EventError",
725	                f"primary key field '{name}' of entity '{node.target_table}' for "
726	                f"'{path}' cannot be a key",
727	            )
728	        _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, type_ref, value, path)
729

731	def _resolve_object(
732	    node: ExecNode,
733	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
734	    ctx: ExecContext,
735	    path: str,
736	) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
737	    """Follow a single-object @link to the unique current target snapshot."""
738	    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, ctx, path)
739	    if local_values is None:
740	        return None
741	
742	    target_store = ctx.snapshots.get(node.target_table)
743	    related = (
744	        _MISSING
745	        if target_store is None
746	        else target_store.rows.get(tuple(local_values), _MISSING)
747	    )
748	    if related is _MISSING:
749	        rendered = ", ".join(
750	            f"{name}: {json.dumps(value)}"
751	            for name, value in zip(node.target, local_values)
752	        )
753	        raise PlanError(
754	            "EventError",
755	            f"no current snapshot of entity '{node.target_table}' for '{path}' "
756	            f"with key {{{rendered}}}",
757	        )
758	    _check_target_fields(node, related, ctx, path)
759	    return related
760	
761	
762	def _resolve_list(
763	    node: ExecNode,
764	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
765	    ctx: ExecContext,
766	    path: str,
767	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
768	    """Match all current target snapshots for a list @link, in insert order.
769	
770	    An empty list stands for both an absent relationship (any local value
771	    null) and one without a current match.
772	    """
773	    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, ctx, path)
774	    if local_values is None:
775	        return []
776	
777	    target_store = ctx.snapshots.get(node.target_table)
778	    if target_store is None:
779	        return []
780	    expected = tuple(local_values)
781	    matches: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
782	    for related in target_store.values():
783	        _check_target_fields(node, related, ctx, path)
784	        values = tuple(related[name] for name in node.target)
785	        if values != expected or None in values:
786	            continue
787	        _check_primary_key(node, ctx, related, path)
788	        matches.append(related)
789	    return matches
790

792	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
793	# Scalar / enum / list shape validation against the schema
794	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
795	
796	
797	def _check_value_shape(
798	    schema: Schema, type_ref, value: Any, path: str
799	) -> None:
800	    """Validate a snapshot value against a field's declared shape.
801	
802	    A null value is accepted for nullable positions and rejected for
803	    non-null ones; lists must be JSON arrays (elements checked recursively,
804	    honoring their own non-null wrappers) and leaf values must belong to the
805	    declared scalar/enum primitive family.
806	    """
807	    non_null = type_ref[0] == "non_null"
808	    if non_null:
809	        type_ref = type_ref[1]
810	    if value is None:
811	        if non_null:
812	            raise PlanError(
813	                "EventError", f"non-null field '{path}' resolved to null"
814	            )
815	        return
816	    if type_ref[0] == "list":
817	        if not isinstance(value, list):
818	            raise PlanError(
819	                "EventError",
820	                f"field '{path}' expects a list but the snapshot value is not an array",
821	            )
822	        for item in value:
823	            _check_value_shape(schema, type_ref[1], item, path)
824	        return
825	    name = type_ref[1]
826	    if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
827	        raise PlanError(
828	            "EventError", f"field '{path}' cannot hold a composite value"
829	        )
830	    if name == "Int":
831	        if not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool):
832	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects an Int value")
833	    elif name == "Float":
834	        if not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or isinstance(value, bool):
835	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects a Float value")
836	    elif name == "String":
837	        if not isinstance(value, str):
838	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects a String value")
839	    elif name == "ID":
840	        if not (
841	            isinstance(value, str)
842	            or (isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool))
843	        ):
844	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects an ID value")
845	    elif name == "Boolean":
846	        if not isinstance(value, bool):
847	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects a Boolean value")
848	    elif name in schema.enums:
849	        if not isinstance(value, str):
850	            raise PlanError(
851	                "EventError", f"enum field '{path}' expects a string enum value"
852	            )
853	    # Other custom scalar names accept any scalar JSON value.

1	"""Subscription push: match entity change events against a subscription.
2	
3	Compiles a subscription operation into an equality filter plus a field
4	projection over a single @entity root, then applies it to an NDJSON stream of
5	entity change events. GraphQL, variable and @entity mapping semantics are
6	shared with the query planner; the supported selection shape covers leaf
7	fields, nested object fields and nested list fields reached through @link
8	joins (one or more levels deep, including aliases and fragment spreads).
9	
10	List fields match every current target snapshot whose @link target field
11	values equal the source's local field values; the matched targets are
12	recursively projected in target insert order. The @link target of a list
13	relationship need not be (part of) the target entity's primary key.
14	"""
15	
16	from __future__ import annotations
17	
18	import json
19	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
20	
21	from .errors import PlanError
22	from .gql import Var, parse_executable
23	from .planner import Planner, _is_list_type
24	from .schema import Entity, TypeInfo, named_of
25	
26	EVENT_OPS = ("INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE")
27	
28	_MISSING = object()
29	
30	
31	class SubscriptionPlan:
32	    """A compiled subscription ready to filter and project event snapshots."""
33	
34	    __slots__ = (
35	        "operation_name",
36	        "path",
37	        "entity_table",
38	        "entity_keys",
39	        "filter",
40	        "tree",
41	    )
42	
43	    def __init__(
44	        self,
45	        operation_name: Optional[str],
46	        path: str,
47	        entity_table: str,
48	        entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
49	        filter_obj: Dict[str, Any],
50	        tree: "LinkedField",
51	    ):
52	        self.operation_name = operation_name
53	        self.path = path
54	        self.entity_table = entity_table
55	        # entity table -> primary key field names, in declared order, for the
56	        # root entity and every entity reachable through selected @link fields
57	        self.entity_keys = entity_keys
58	        self.filter = filter_obj  # entity field name -> expected value
59	        self.tree = tree  # compiled selection tree rooted at the root field
60	
61	    def matches(self, snapshot: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
62	        for name, expected in self.filter.items():
63	            if name not in snapshot:
64	                raise PlanError(
65	                    "EventError", f"snapshot is missing filter field '{name}'"
66	                )
67	            if snapshot[name] != expected:
68	                return False
69	        return True
70	
71	
72	class LinkedField:
73	    """A compiled field in the subscription selection tree.
74	
75	    Leaf fields carry ``field_name`` and no children. Link fields carry the
76	    validated @link mapping (local/target field names, target entity) and a
77	    list of compiled children; ``is_list`` selects list (ordered, possibly
78	    many) rather than single-object resolution.
79	    """
80	
81	    __slots__ = (
82	        "response_key",
83	        "field_name",
84	        "required",
85	        "is_list",
86	        "local",
87	        "target",
88	        "target_table",
89	        "children",
90	    )
91	
92	    def __init__(
93	        self,
94	        response_key: str,
95	        field_name: str,
96	        required: bool = False,
97	        is_list: bool = False,
98	        local: Optional[List[str]] = None,
99	        target: Optional[List[str]] = None,
100	        target_table: Optional[str] = None,
101	        children: Optional[List["LinkedField"]] = None,
102	    ):
103	        self.response_key = response_key
104	        self.field_name = field_name
105	        self.required = required  # field declared as a non-null object type
106	        self.is_list = is_list
107	        self.local = local  # source-side key field names, in @link order
108	        self.target = target  # target-side matched field names, in @link order
109	        self.target_table = target_table
110	        self.children = children
111	
112	
113	class SubscriptionCompiler(Planner):
114	    """Reuses the planner's fragment expansion and variable resolution."""
115	
116	    def __init__(self, schema, variables, bound_args_allowed: bool = False):
117	        super().__init__(schema, variables, bound_args_allowed)
118	
119	    def compile(
120	        self, subscription_text: str, source: str, operation_name: Optional[str]
121	    ) -> SubscriptionPlan:
122	        operations, self.fragments = parse_executable(subscription_text, source)
123	        op = self._select_operation(operations, operation_name)
124	        self.var_map = {}
125	        for name, type_ref, default, has_default in op.var_defs:
126	            if name in self.var_map:
127	                raise PlanError(
128	                    "VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' is declared more than once"
129	                )
130	            self.var_map[name] = (type_ref, default, has_default)
131	
132	        root_type_name = self.schema.roots.get("subscription")
133	        root_type = self.schema.types.get(root_type_name) if root_type_name else None
134	        if root_type is None:
135	            raise PlanError(
136	                "MappingError",
137	                "schema does not define a root type for subscription operations",
138	            )
139	
140	        selections = self._expand(op.selection_set, root_type.name, [])
141	        if not selections:
142	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "subscription has an empty selection set")
143	        if len(selections) != 1:
144	            raise PlanError(
145	                "InvalidQuery", "subscription must select exactly one root field"
146	            )
147	        node = selections[0]
148	        key = node.alias or node.name
149	
150	        field = root_type.fields.get(node.name)
151	        if field is None:
152	            raise PlanError(
153	                "InvalidQuery",
154	                f"unknown root field '{node.name}' on type '{root_type.name}'",
155	            )
156	        type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
157	        target = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
158	        entity = target.entity if target is not None else None
159	        if entity is None:
160	            raise PlanError(
161	                "MappingError",
162	                f"root field '{node.name}' does not return a mapped entity type",
163	            )
164	        if node.selection_set is None:
165	            raise PlanError(
166	                "InvalidQuery", f"root field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
167	            )
168	
169	        filter_obj = self._compile_filter(field, target, entity.table, node)
170	        entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]] = {entity.table: list(entity.key)}
171	        children = self._compile_fields(
172	            target, entity, node.selection_set, key, entity_keys
173	        )
174	        tree = LinkedField(key, key, children=children)
175	        return SubscriptionPlan(
176	            op.name, key, entity.table, entity_keys, filter_obj, tree
177	        )
178	
179	    # -- operation selection ---------------------------------------------------
180	
181	    @staticmethod
182	    def _select_operation(operations, operation_name):
183	        if operation_name is not None:
184	            for op in operations:
185	                if op.name == operation_name and op.op_type == "subscription":
186	                    return op
187	            raise PlanError(
188	                "InvalidQuery", f"no subscription named '{operation_name}'"
189	            )
190	        if not operations:
191	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "document contains no operations")
192	        if len(operations) != 1:
193	            raise PlanError(
194	                "InvalidQuery",
195	                "multiple operations found; select one with --operation",
196	            )
197	        op = operations[0]
198	        if op.op_type != "subscription":
199	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "operation must be a subscription")
200	        return op
201	
202	    # -- filter ------------------------------------------------------------------
203	
204	    def _compile_filter(self, field, target, table, node) -> Dict[str, Any]:
205	        for arg_name, arg_def in field.args.items():
206	            if (
207	                arg_def.type[0] == "non_null"
208	                and not arg_def.has_default
209	                and arg_name not in node.args
210	            ):
211	                raise PlanError(
212	                    "InvalidQuery",
213	                    f"missing required argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
214	                )
215	        is_list = _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
216	        filter_obj: Dict[str, Any] = {}
217	        for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
218	            if self._accepts_bound_arg(is_list, arg_name):
219	                # A list-size bound used for complexity; never a filter. If it
220	                # is a variable, resolve it so type/required-variable errors
221	                # are reported by the normal validation phase.
222	                if isinstance(value, Var):
223	                    self._resolve(value)
224	                continue
225	            if arg_name not in field.args:
226	                raise PlanError(
227	                    "InvalidQuery",
228	                    f"unknown argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
229	                )
230	            target_field = target.fields.get(arg_name)
231	            if target_field is None or not self.schema.is_leaf(
232	                named_of(target_field.type_ref)
233	            ):
234	                raise PlanError(
235	                    "InvalidQuery",
236	                    f"argument '{arg_name}' does not match a filterable field of entity '{table}'",
237	                )
238	            filter_obj[arg_name] = self._resolve(value)
239	        return filter_obj

241	    # -- selection tree -----------------------------------------------------------
242	
243	    def _compile_fields(
244	        self,
245	        info: TypeInfo,
246	        entity: Entity,
247	        selection_set,
248	        path: str,
249	        entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
250	    ) -> List[LinkedField]:
251	        selections = self._expand(selection_set, info.name, [])
252	        if not selections:
253	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", f"empty selection set at '{path}'")
254	        children: List[LinkedField] = []
255	        seen = set()
256	        for node in selections:
257	            key = node.alias or node.name
258	            node_path = f"{path}.{key}"
259	            field = info.fields.get(node.name)
260	            if field is None:
261	                raise PlanError(
262	                    "InvalidQuery",
263	                    f"unknown field '{node.name}' on type '{info.name}'",
264	                )
265	            type_name = named_of(field.type_ref)
266	            if self.schema.is_leaf(type_name):
267	                if node.selection_set is not None:
268	                    raise PlanError(
269	                        "InvalidQuery",
270	                        f"scalar field '{node.name}' must not have a selection set",
271	                    )
272	                if node.args:
273	                    raise PlanError(
274	                        "InvalidQuery",
275	                        f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
276	                    )
277	                if key not in seen:
278	                    seen.add(key)
279	                    children.append(LinkedField(key, node.name))
280	                continue
281	            is_list = _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
282	            for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
283	                if self._accepts_bound_arg(is_list, arg_name):
284	                    if isinstance(value, Var):
285	                        self._resolve(value)
286	                    continue
287	                raise PlanError(
288	                    "InvalidQuery",
289	                    f"arguments on field '{node.name}' are not supported",
290	                )
291	            if node.selection_set is None:
292	                raise PlanError(
293	                    "InvalidQuery", f"field '{node.name}' requires a selection set"
294	                )
295	            required = field.type_ref[0] == "non_null"
296	            if field.link is None:
297	                raise PlanError(
298	                    "MappingError",
299	                    f"field '{info.name}.{node.name}' is missing an @link directive",
300	                )
301	            target_info = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
302	            if target_info is None:
303	                raise PlanError(
304	                    "MappingError",
305	                    f"field '{info.name}.{node.name}' has unsupported type '{type_name}'",
306	                )
307	            target_entity = target_info.entity
308	            if target_entity is None:
309	                raise PlanError(
310	                    "UnknownEntity",
311	                    f"type '{target_info.name}' is not mapped to an entity",
312	                )
313	            local, target_key, _as_array = field.link
314	            if is_list:
315	                # A list relationship matches equality on arbitrary scalar
316	                # target fields (they need not form the target primary key),
317	                # so every matched field must hold a single scalar value.
318	                for name in local:
319	                    matched_local = info.fields.get(name)
320	                    if not _is_scalar_value_field(self.schema, matched_local):
321	                        raise PlanError(
322	                            "MappingError",
323	                            f"@link local field '{name}' of type '{info.name}' "
324	                            f"must be a scalar",
325	                        )
326	                for name in target_key:
327	                    matched = target_info.fields.get(name)
328	                    if matched is None:
329	                        raise PlanError(
330	                            "MappingError",
331	                            f"@link target field '{name}' is not a field of type "
332	                            f"'{target_info.name}'",
333	                        )
334	                    if not _is_scalar_value_field(self.schema, matched):
335	                        raise PlanError(
336	                            "MappingError",
337	                            f"@link target field '{name}' of type "
338	                            f"'{target_info.name}' must be a scalar",
339	                        )
340	            elif target_key != target_entity.key:
341	                raise PlanError(
342	                    "InvalidJoin",
343	                    f"@link target {target_key} does not match the primary key of "
344	                    f"entity '{target_entity.table}'",
345	                )
346	            nested = self._compile_fields(
347	                target_info,
348	                target_entity,
349	                node.selection_set,
350	                node_path,
351	                entity_keys,
352	            )
353	            if key not in seen:
354	                seen.add(key)
355	                entity_keys[target_entity.table] = list(target_entity.key)
356	                children.append(
357	                    LinkedField(
358	                        key,
359	                        node.name,
360	                        required=required,
361	                        is_list=is_list,
362	                        local=list(local),
363	                        target=list(target_key),
364	                        target_table=target_entity.table,
365	                        children=nested,
366	                    )
367	                )
368	        return children

371	def _is_scalar_value_field(schema, field) -> bool:
372	    """Whether a field holds a single (non-list) built-in/custom scalar."""
373	    if field is None:
374	        return False
375	    return (
376	        not _is_list_type(field.type_ref)
377	        and named_of(field.type_ref) in schema.scalars
378	    )

381	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
382	# Event processing
383	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
384	
385	
386	class _OrderedStore:
387	    """Latest snapshots of one entity, kept in insert order.
388	
389	    INSERT introduces a new row at the end; UPDATE replaces a row in place and
390	    preserves its position; DELETE removes a row, so a later re-INSERT is
391	    appended at the end again. Snapshots whose primary key cannot be built
392	    cannot participate in keyed identity (and therefore cannot be deleted by
393	    key); they are retained separately so a list match on non-key target
394	    fields can surface them as an EventError instead of silently dropping them.
395	    """
396	
397	    __slots__ = ("rows", "keyless")
398	
399	    def __init__(self):
400	        self.rows: Dict[Tuple[Any, ...], Dict[str, Any]] = {}
401	        self.keyless: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
402	
403	    def upsert(self, key: Optional[Tuple[Any, ...]], snapshot: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
404	        # Dict assignment appends a new key at the end and replaces an existing
405	        # key's value without moving it, which is exactly the required order.
406	        if key is None:
407	            self.keyless.append(snapshot)
408	        else:
409	            self.rows[key] = snapshot
410	
411	    def delete(self, key: Optional[Tuple[Any, ...]]) -> None:
412	        # A keyed row is removed so a later upsert re-appends it at the end; a
413	        # keyless DELETE cannot identify a stored row and leaves them untouched.
414	        if key is not None:
415	            self.rows.pop(key, None)
416	
417	    def values(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
418	        return list(self.rows.values())
419	
420	
421	def push_events(
422	    plan: SubscriptionPlan, events_text: str, source: str
423	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
424	    """Apply a compiled subscription to an NDJSON event stream, in order.
425	
426	    Every line is parsed and validated first; the latest snapshot of each
427	    entity is then maintained by primary key, and matching root events are
428	    projected against the snapshots known up to and including that line.
429	    """
430	    events: List[Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]] = []
431	    for lineno, raw in enumerate(events_text.splitlines(), 1):
432	        line = raw.strip()
433	        if not line:
434	            continue
435	        events.append((lineno, _parse_event(line, source, lineno)))
436	
437	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore] = {}
438	    outputs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
439	    for lineno, event in events:
440	        _apply_event(plan.entity_keys, snapshots, event)
441	        if event["entity"] != plan.entity_table:
442	            continue
443	        op = event["op"]
444	        snapshot = event["after"] if op in ("INSERT", "UPDATE") else event["before"]
445	        if snapshot is None:
446	            raise PlanError(
447	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: {op} event has no snapshot"
448	            )
449	        if not plan.matches(snapshot):
450	            continue
451	        data = _project(
452	            plan.tree.children,
453	            snapshot,
454	            snapshots,
455	            plan.entity_keys,
456	            source,
457	            lineno,
458	            plan.path,
459	        )
460	        outputs.append(
461	            {
462	                "subscription": plan.operation_name,
463	                "path": plan.path,
464	                "event": op,
465	                "entity": event["entity"],
466	                "data": data,
467	            }
468	        )
469	    return outputs
470	
471	
472	def _apply_event(
473	    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
474	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
475	    event: Dict[str, Any],
476	) -> None:
477	    """Update the latest-snapshot store for one validated event.
478	
479	    Events for entities the subscription cannot reach are ignored. Rows whose
480	    snapshot lacks a usable primary key cannot identify an entity; they are
481	    skipped here and surface as an EventError when a matching root event tries
482	    to traverse the relationship, rather than at their own line.
483	    """
484	    key_fields = entity_keys.get(event["entity"])
485	    if key_fields is None:
486	        return
487	    store = snapshots.setdefault(event["entity"], _OrderedStore())
488	    if event["op"] in ("INSERT", "UPDATE"):
489	        snapshot = event["after"]
490	        if snapshot is not None:
491	            store.upsert(_key_tuple(key_fields, snapshot), snapshot)
492	        return
493	    snapshot = event["before"]
494	    if snapshot is not None:
495	        store.delete(_key_tuple(key_fields, snapshot))
496	
497	
498	def _key_tuple(
499	    key_fields: List[str], snapshot: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
500	) -> Optional[Tuple[Any, ...]]:
501	    """Build a primary-key tuple, or None when the snapshot cannot supply one."""
502	    if not isinstance(snapshot, dict):
503	        return None
504	    values: List[Any] = []
505	    for name in key_fields:
506	        value = snapshot.get(name)
507	        if value is None or isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
508	            return None
509	        values.append(value)
510	    return tuple(values)
511	
512	
513	def _project(
514	    nodes: List[LinkedField],
515	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
516	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
517	    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
518	    source: str,
519	    lineno: int,
520	    path: str,
521	) -> Dict[str, Any]:
522	    """Project compiled selections over one entity snapshot."""
523	    data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
524	    for node in nodes:
525	        node_path = f"{path}.{node.response_key}"
526	        if node.children is None:
527	            if node.field_name not in snapshot:
528	                raise PlanError(
529	                    "EventError",
530	                    f"{source}:{lineno}: snapshot is missing field "
531	                    f"'{node.field_name}'",
532	                )
533	            data[node.response_key] = snapshot[node.field_name]
534	            continue
535	        if node.is_list:
536	            data[node.response_key] = _project_list(
537	                node, snapshot, snapshots, entity_keys, source, lineno, node_path
538	            )
539	            continue
540	        related = _resolve_object(node, snapshot, snapshots, source, lineno, node_path)
541	        if related is None:
542	            if node.required:
543	                raise PlanError(
544	                    "EventError",
545	                    f"{source}:{lineno}: non-null relationship '{node_path}' "
546	                    f"resolved to null",
547	                )
548	            data[node.response_key] = None
549	        else:
550	            data[node.response_key] = _project(
551	                node.children,
552	                related,
553	                snapshots,
554	                entity_keys,
555	                source,
556	                lineno,
557	                node_path,
558	            )
559	    return data
560	
561	
562	def _project_list(
563	    node: LinkedField,
564	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
565	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
566	    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
567	    source: str,
568	    lineno: int,
569	    path: str,
570	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
571	    """Resolve a list @link and project each matched target snapshot."""
572	    matches = _resolve_list(
573	        node, snapshot, snapshots, entity_keys, source, lineno, path
574	    )
575	    return [
576	        _project(
577	            node.children,
578	            related,
579	            snapshots,
580	            entity_keys,
581	            source,
582	            lineno,
583	            path,
584	        )
585	        for related in matches
586	    ]
587	
588	
589	def _read_local(
590	    node: LinkedField,
591	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
592	    source: str,
593	    lineno: int,
594	    path: str,
595	) -> Optional[List[Any]]:
596	    """Read the @link local key values from a source snapshot.
597	
598	    Returns None when any local value is null (the relationship itself is
599	    absent). Missing local key fields or values that cannot form a scalar key
600	    end the stream with EventError.
601	    """
602	    local_values: List[Any] = []
603	    for name in node.local:
604	        if name not in snapshot:
605	            raise PlanError(
606	                "EventError",
607	                f"{source}:{lineno}: snapshot is missing local key field "
608	                f"'{name}' for '{path}'",
609	            )
610	        value = snapshot[name]
611	        if value is None:
612	            return None
613	        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
614	            raise PlanError(
615	                "EventError",
616	                f"{source}:{lineno}: local key field '{name}' for '{path}' "
617	                f"cannot form a scalar key",
618	            )
619	        local_values.append(value)
620	    return local_values
621	
622	
623	def _check_target_fields(
624	    node: LinkedField,
625	    related: Dict[str, Any],
626	    source: str,
627	    lineno: int,
628	    path: str,
629	) -> None:
630	    """Ensure every matched target field is present (and scalar) on a snapshot."""
631	    for name in node.target:
632	        if name not in related:
633	            raise PlanError(
634	                "EventError",
635	                f"{source}:{lineno}: target snapshot is missing key field "
636	                f"'{name}' for '{path}'",
637	            )
638	        if isinstance(related[name], (dict, list)):
639	            raise PlanError(
640	                "EventError",
641	                f"{source}:{lineno}: target key field '{name}' for '{path}' "
642	                f"cannot be matched as a scalar",
643	            )
644	
645	
646	def _check_primary_key(
647	    table: str,
648	    key_fields: List[str],
649	    related: Dict[str, Any],
650	    source: str,
651	    lineno: int,
652	    path: str,
653	) -> None:
654	    """Ensure a matched target snapshot supplies its scalar primary key."""
655	    for name in key_fields:
656	        if name not in related:
657	            raise PlanError(
658	                "EventError",
659	                f"{source}:{lineno}: target snapshot of entity '{table}' for "
660	                f"'{path}' is missing primary key field '{name}'",
661	            )
662	        if isinstance(related[name], (dict, list)):
663	            raise PlanError(
664	                "EventError",
665	                f"{source}:{lineno}: primary key field '{name}' of entity "
666	                f"'{table}' for '{path}' cannot be a key",
667	            )

669	
670	def _resolve_object(
671	    node: LinkedField,
672	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
673	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
674	    source: str,
675	    lineno: int,
676	    path: str,
677	) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
678	    """Follow one single-object @link to the latest target snapshot.
679	
680	    Returns None when any local key value is null (the relationship itself is
681	    absent). Missing local key fields, values that cannot form the target
682	    primary key or a target key without a current snapshot end the stream with
683	    EventError.
684	    """
685	    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, source, lineno, path)
686	    if local_values is None:
687	        return None
688	
689	    target_store = snapshots.get(node.target_table)
690	    related = (
691	        _MISSING
692	        if target_store is None
693	        else target_store.rows.get(tuple(local_values), _MISSING)
694	    )
695	    if related is _MISSING:
696	        rendered = ", ".join(
697	            f"{name}: {json.dumps(value)}"
698	            for name, value in zip(node.target, local_values)
699	        )
700	        raise PlanError(
701	            "EventError",
702	            f"{source}:{lineno}: no current snapshot of entity "
703	            f"'{node.target_table}' for '{path}' with key {{{rendered}}}",
704	        )
705	    _check_target_fields(node, related, source, lineno, path)
706	    return related
707	
708	
709	def _resolve_list(
710	    node: LinkedField,
711	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
712	    snapshots: Dict[str, _OrderedStore],
713	    entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]],
714	    source: str,
715	    lineno: int,
716	    path: str,
717	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
718	    """Match all current target snapshots for a list @link, in insert order.
719	
720	    An empty list stands for both an absent relationship (any local value
721	    null) and a relationship without a current match. Local key fields that
722	    are missing or non-scalar, and matched target snapshots that lack a target
723	    field or a usable primary key, end the stream with EventError.
724	    """
725	    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, source, lineno, path)
726	    if local_values is None:
727	        return []
728	
729	    target_store = snapshots.get(node.target_table)
730	    if target_store is None:
731	        return []
732	    pk_fields = entity_keys[node.target_table]
733	    expected = tuple(local_values)
734	    matches: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
735	    candidates = list(target_store.rows.values()) + list(target_store.keyless)
736	    for related in candidates:
737	        _check_target_fields(node, related, source, lineno, path)
738	        values = tuple(related[name] for name in node.target)
739	        if values != expected or None in values:
740	            continue
741	        _check_primary_key(
742	            node.target_table, pk_fields, related, source, lineno, path
743	        )
744	        matches.append(related)
745	    return matches
746	
747	
748	def _parse_event(line: str, source: str, lineno: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
749	    try:
750	        event = json.loads(line)
751	    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
752	        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: invalid JSON: {exc.msg}")
753	    if not isinstance(event, dict):
754	        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event must be a JSON object")
755	    for key in ("op", "entity", "before", "after"):
756	        if key not in event:
757	            raise PlanError(
758	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event is missing '{key}'"
759	            )
760	    if event["op"] not in EVENT_OPS:
761	        raise PlanError(
762	            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: unknown op {event['op']!r}"
763	        )
764	    if not isinstance(event["entity"], str):
765	        raise PlanError(
766	            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: 'entity' must be a string"
767	        )
768	    for key in ("before", "after"):
769	        if event[key] is not None and not isinstance(event[key], dict):
770	            raise PlanError(
771	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: '{key}' must be an object or null"
772	            )
773	    return event

"""graph-index command line interface."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys

from .complexity import (
    QueryComplexityExceeded,
    complexity_error_payload,
    enforce_complexity,
    load_limit_from_env,
)
from .errors import PlanError
from .executor import ExecContext, QueryCompiler, execute, fold_events
from .planner import Planner
from .schema import load_schema
from .subscription import SubscriptionCompiler, push_events


def _read_text_file(path: str) -> str:
    try:
        with open(path, "rb") as handle:
            data = handle.read()
    except OSError as exc:
        raise PlanError("IoError", f"cannot read '{path}': {exc.strerror or exc}")
    try:
        return data.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        raise PlanError("IoError", f"'{path}' is not valid UTF-8")


def _load_variables(variables_text: str, source: str) -> dict:
    try:
        variables = json.loads(variables_text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise PlanError(
            "ParseError",
            f"{source}:{exc.lineno}:{exc.colno}: invalid JSON: {exc.msg}",
        )
    if not isinstance(variables, dict):
        raise PlanError("VariablesError", f"'{source}' must contain a JSON object")
    return variables


def _cmd_query_plan(args) -> dict:
    schema_text = _read_text_file(args.schema)
    query_text = _read_text_file(args.query)
    variables_text = _read_text_file(args.variables)

    schema = load_schema(schema_text, args.schema)
    variables = _load_variables(variables_text, args.variables)

    planner = Planner(schema, variables)
    return planner.plan(query_text, args.query, args.operation)


def _cmd_subscription_push(args, complexity_limit) -> list:
    schema_text = _read_text_file(args.schema)
    subscription_text = _read_text_file(args.subscription)
    variables_text = _read_text_file(args.variables)
    events_text = _read_text_file(args.events)

    schema = load_schema(schema_text, args.schema)
    variables = _load_variables(variables_text, args.variables)

    compiler = SubscriptionCompiler(
        schema, variables, bound_args_allowed=complexity_limit is not None
    )
    plan = compiler.compile(subscription_text, args.subscription, args.operation)
    if complexity_limit is not None:
        # Gate before any subscription is established or event is processed.
        enforce_complexity(
            schema,
            variables,
            subscription_text,
            args.subscription,
            args.operation,
            SubscriptionCompiler._select_operation,
            complexity_limit,
        )
    return push_events(plan, events_text, args.events)


def _cmd_query_exec(args, complexity_limit) -> dict:
    schema_text = _read_text_file(args.schema)
    query_text = _read_text_file(args.query)
    variables_text = _read_text_file(args.variables)
    events_text = _read_text_file(args.events)

    schema = load_schema(schema_text, args.schema)
    variables = _load_variables(variables_text, args.variables)

    compiler = QueryCompiler(
        schema, variables, bound_args_allowed=complexity_limit is not None
    )
    _operation_name, roots = compiler.compile(
        query_text, args.query, args.operation
    )
    if complexity_limit is not None:
        # Gate after the document/variables have passed ordinary validation but
        # before any indexed entity is read (events are folded only afterwards).
        enforce_complexity(
            schema,
            variables,
            query_text,
            args.query,
            args.operation,
            QueryCompiler._select_operation,
            complexity_limit,
        )
    ctx = ExecContext(schema, compiler.entity_keys, compiler.key_types)
    # A query that only asks for introspection/meta-fields still requires the
    # events file to be readable, but its events are never parsed or folded.
    if any("response_key" in root for root in roots):
        fold_events(ctx, events_text, args.events)
    return execute(roots, ctx)


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="graph-index",
        description="Blockchain data index and GraphQL query service tooling.",
    )
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    query_plan = sub.add_parser(
        "query-plan", help="compile a GraphQL query into an entity scan/join plan"
    )
    query_plan.add_argument("--schema", required=True, help="GraphQL schema file (SDL)")
    query_plan.add_argument("--query", required=True, help="GraphQL query file")
    query_plan.add_argument("--variables", required=True, help="variables JSON file")
    query_plan.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        default=None,
        help="operation name to select when the document has several",
    )
    subscription_push = sub.add_parser(
        "subscription-push",
        help="push entity change events matching a GraphQL subscription as JSONL",
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--schema", required=True, help="GraphQL schema file (SDL)"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--subscription", required=True, help="GraphQL subscription file"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--variables", required=True, help="variables JSON file"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--events", required=True, help="entity change events file (NDJSON)"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        default=None,
        help="operation name to select when the document has several",
    )
    query_exec = sub.add_parser(
        "query-exec",
        help="execute a GraphQL query over entity change events",
    )
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--schema", required=True, help="GraphQL schema file (SDL)"
    )
    query_exec.add_argument("--query", required=True, help="GraphQL query file")
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--variables", required=True, help="variables JSON file"
    )
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--events", required=True, help="entity change events file (NDJSON)"
    )
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        default=None,
        help="operation name to select when the document has several",
    )
    return parser


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        # Read and validate the complexity limit at startup, before the command
        # opens anything: an invalid value fails with the unique diagnostic
        # code INVALID_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT. Absent/0 disables the control.
        complexity_limit = load_limit_from_env()
    except PlanError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(
            json.dumps({"code": exc.code, "message": exc.message}, ensure_ascii=False)
            + "\n"
        )
        return 2
    try:
        if args.command == "query-plan":
            result = _cmd_query_plan(args)
            sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
            return 0
        if args.command == "subscription-push":
            try:
                rows = _cmd_subscription_push(args, complexity_limit)
            except QueryComplexityExceeded as exc:
                sys.stdout.write(
                    json.dumps(
                        complexity_error_payload(exc.complexity, exc.limit),
                        ensure_ascii=False,
                        indent=2,
                    )
                    + "\n"
                )
                return 0
            for row in rows:
                sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            return 0
        if args.command == "query-exec":
            try:
                result = _cmd_query_exec(args, complexity_limit)
            except QueryComplexityExceeded as exc:
                # Deterministic stop: data is null and the single error carries
                # QUERY_COMPLEXITY_EXCEEDED; no resolver ran and no entity was
                # read, so the response is still a normal GraphQL success exit.
                result = complexity_error_payload(exc.complexity, exc.limit)
            sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
            return 0
        raise PlanError("InvalidRequest", f"unknown command '{args.command}'")
    except PlanError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(
            json.dumps({"code": exc.code, "message": exc.message}, ensure_ascii=False)
            + "\n"
        )
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":  # pragma: no cover
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Error type carrying a stable machine-readable code."""


class PlanError(Exception):
    """An error that maps to a JSON object on stderr and exit code 2."""

    def __init__(self, code, message):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.code = code
        self.message = message

25-## 查询复杂度控制
26-
27-通过环境变量 `GRAPHQL_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT` 在服务启动时开启：变量缺省或值为 `0` 时功能关闭；值为正整数时为单次 operation 的最大复杂度；负数、非整数或无法解析的值使启动失败（不执行任何命令），向 stderr 输出 `{code: "INVALID_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT", message}` 并以退出码 2 结束。

30-
31-- 从 operation 根 selection set 开始；每个叶子字段计 1，组合字段只累计其子 selection（对象容器自身计 0）；

19:- `__schema` 返回 `__Schema`：`queryType`/`mutationType`/`subscriptionType`（未声明的根类型返回 `null`）、`types`（全部内置标量、自定义标量、object、interface、union、enum、input object 及内省元类型，顺序确定、不重复）与 `directives`（内置 `skip`/`include`/`deprecated`/`specifiedBy` 加 SDL 中声明的 directive，含 `args`、`locations`、`isRepeatable`）。
20-- `__type(name: String!)` 按名称返回对应 `__Type`，未知名称返回 `null`。各类型 `kind`（SCALAR/OBJECT/INTERFACE/UNION/ENUM/INPUT_OBJECT/LIST/NON_NULL）、`name`、LIST/NON_NULL 的 `ofType` 包装结构，以及可展开关系均为确定结果：object/interface 的 `fields`（含参数 `args`、参数 `defaultValue` 字符串、字段 `type` 包装）与 `interfaces`；interface/union 的 `possibleTypes`；enum 的 `enumValues`；input object 的 `inputFields`。与当前类型 kind 不适用的关系字段返回 `null`；未请求的字段一律不出现在结果中。`defaultValue` 以 GraphQL 常量值语法的字符串形式给出。描述与弃用未在 SDL 中建模，故 `description`/`deprecationReason`/`specifiedByURL` 为 `null`，`isDeprecated` 恒为 `false`，`includeDeprecated` 参数被接受但不影响结果。
21-- `__typename` 可出现在任意对象（含 query 根、内省元类型对象）选择集中，返回该对象类型的名称；别名、片段展开沿用实体选择的既有合并语义。
22-- `__schema` 不接受实参且必须带 selection set；`__type` 必须提供 `name` 且不接受其他实参，`name` 字面量必须是 String（枚举名/数字/布尔等非 String 字面量）或类型为 String 的变量；内省字段上出现未声明实参、缺少 selection set、在非根对象上选择 `__schema`/`__type`、给 `__typename` 传参数或附加 selection set，均以 `InvalidQuery` 结束（元类型上的未知字段仍为 `UnknownField`）。`name` 由变量提供但变量缺失、未声明或类型不符时以 `VariablesError` 结束。
23-- 内省与 `__typename` 在复杂度控制关闭时同样可用；控制开启时复杂度均为 0，已有 `QUERY_COMPLEXITY_EXCEEDED` 判定不变。只含根级内省/`__typename` 的查询仍要求 `--events` 文件可读，但不解析也不折叠其中事件；与实体根字段混合时，实体部分继续按当前快照、连接与顺序执行，事件仍逐行解析校验。
24-
25-## 查询复杂度控制
26-
27-通过环境变量 `GRAPHQL_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT` 在服务启动时开启：变量缺省或值为 `0` 时功能关闭；值为正整数时为单次 operation 的最大复杂度；负数、非整数或无法解析的值使启动失败（不执行任何命令），向 stderr 输出 `{code: "INVALID_QUERY_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT", message}` 并以退出码 2 结束。
28-
29-复杂度在真正执行解析器、读取索引实体或建立订阅之前，按同一份 GraphQL 文档与变量、对请求选定的单个 operation 计算（未选中的 operation 不计入）：
30-
31-- 从 operation 根 selection set 开始；每个叶子字段计 1，组合字段只累计其子 selection（对象容器自身计 0）；
32-- 重复字段与不同 alias 分别计分（即便执行阶段按 response key 合并，复杂度仍按原始选择逐个计）；
33-- fragment 在展开位置计入一次（同一 fragment 展开两处即计两处），inline fragment 直接计入其选择；类型条件不匹配当前类型的片段计 0；
34-- 内省字段 `__schema`、`__type` 以及隐式元字段 `__typename` 计 0；
35-- 列表字段按有效条目上界放大其子 selection：优先读取字段参数 `first`，其次 `limit` 的正整数面值，也接受对应变量（含变量默认值）的正整数值；参数缺失、值非正或非整数时按 `1000` 计。变量本身的 GraphQL 类型校验仍由既有校验阶段负责（类型不符仍为 `VariablesError`）。嵌套列表的上界逐层相乘。
36-
37:判定确定：复杂度等于上限时允许执行并沿用既有查询路径、数据结构与顺序；严格大于上限时不调用解析器、不读取索引实体（query-exec 不再折叠事件）、不建立订阅（subscription-push 不产生任何推送），也没有持久化副作用。此时 query-exec 在 stdout 输出一次 GraphQL 响应、退出码 0：`data` 为 `null`，`errors` 恰有一个，其 `extensions.code` 为 `QUERY_COMPLEXITY_EXCEEDED`；subscription-push 以同一 GraphQL 响应代替 JSONL 输出。查询计划产生的分批取数不重复计费，订阅建立后推送的数据也不再次计费。
38-
39-畸形文档、变量类型错误、未知字段或 fragment 循环继续返回既有 GraphQL 校验错误（如 `ParseError`/`VariablesError`/`UnknownField`/`InvalidQuery`），不会被改写为复杂度错误；这些校验先于复杂度判定。`first`/`limit` 参数仅在复杂度控制开启、且字段为列表类型时被接受（不计入实体过滤）；功能关闭时仍按原规则报未知/不支持参数。`query-plan` 子命令不实施复杂度控制。
40-
41-## 约定

44-- 后续需求在此基线上增量实现。
45:- `@entity` 的 `key` 接收字符串或字符串数组（复合主键，如 `key: ["chain_id", "id"]`）；`@link` 的 `local` 与 `target` 同样各接收字符串或等长字符串数组。复合 key/local/target 均为非空且元素互不相同的字符串数组；空数组、重复元素、缺失字段、非标量字段、混合参数形式或数量不一致均以 `MappingError` 结束。复合连接在计划中以单条 join 输出，`fromField`/`toField` 为按声明顺序排列的字段数组；单字段 `@link` 仍输出字符串字段名。`@link` 的 `target` 未按顺序完整指向目标实体主键时以 `InvalidJoin` 结束（query-plan 与 subscription-push 的单对象关系均如此）；subscription-push 的列表关系改为等值匹配，target 可以不是主键，只要求对应字段存在且为标量。
